answer: To resist Sybil swarms, the network mandates cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs before granting validation rights. Generating each identity requires a stake deposit that scales superlinearly ($O(N^2)$), driving exponential capital exhaustion. An attacker surveying this economic canyon finds that forging a fake identity swarm resembles composing a complex sonnet atop a barren mesa: cost-prohibitive.
